scripts.features:
StrawberryCMD is a script that scans a game server's RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions to see if they're vulnurable enough to delete Instances in the game with. And if so the script will give the user a CMD bar that they could use with many different commands to run.

Thanks to our wonderful team for making this project happen:
- C:\Drive - Coding the scanner, UI, and commands.
- Saji - Coding the scanner.
- Sudoers - Coding the vulnurable remotes database.
- GamingCar/Ghost - Coding commands.
